notes.title: V1.6.4.1 Update Announcement
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
Fixed an issue where, in certain cases, the castle could not accumulate damage after exiting Endless Mode and then continuing the game.

[b]Mods Issues[/b]
Recently, we received feedback from some players regarding abnormal issues with Mods. Upon investigation, we confirmed that there are indeed some problems with the Mods plugin. As a result, we plan to temporarily remove the Mods feature. We appreciate your understanding.

notes.title: Mods Feature Temporarily Disabled
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We've recently received feedback from some players about issues with the game Mods. After investigation, we've identified some problems with the Mods plugins. 
As a result, we have decided to temporarily disable the Mods feature.
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and negative experience caused.

The Mods feature will be disabled starting from: February 24th, 9:00（PST）.

If you have any other questions about the game, feel free to join our Discord and share your concerns with us.

Thank you!

notes.title: Dog and Goblin, a Luck be a Landlord-style roguelike card game, is now availale!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! The full version of Dog and Goblin, a roguelike card-building game with synthesis mechanics inspired by Luck be a Landlord and auto-chess gameplay, is officially released! 
For the first two weeks, enjoy a 10% discount, making it only $7.19. 
Feel free to go to the Steam to purchase or add it to your wishlist. 
If you haven't tried the game yet, you can also download the free demo to experience it before buying!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739576/a1b05f02eced54ee7fbeb24045c402d83295f8b9.jpg[/img]

The game currently features 6 characters, each with 6 progressively unlocked difficulty levels, and 7 completely different gameplay rules to choose from. For example, under Great Fortune rules, a thief appears every 8 waves, a king every 13 waves, while enemy numbers increase progressively. Players start with 40 refresh and delete coins, balancing risk and reward, emphasizing strategy and game understanding. This enhances the game's replay value and overall enjoyment.

[b]Future update plans for the game:[/b]
[list]
[*] New enemies and new cards
[*] Four new challenge modes
[*] Endless mode
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739576/72317e1f355ef23240834c7cdb8f85238d1d4218.jpg[/img]

Dog and Goblin is an auto-battler Roguelike deck-building strategy game where you assemble a mixed army to stand against humans. With nearly 150 units across 19 different types, build your ultimate army and conquer their castles!

notes.title: [Official Announcement] Roguelike deck-builder Dog and Goblin playtest is open!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! We are excited to announce that OKJOY is publishing the auto-battler roguelike deck-building strategy game Dog and Goblin, developed by the two-person team at Zony Studio.

Today, the playtest goes live on Steam, and we invite you all to download and try it out! This playtest will feature around 40 cards, multiple different deck-building strategies, a revamped synthesis system with 30 new recipes, one character, and six difficulty levels. The test is expected to last for 1-2 weeks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739576/e0bc330d8c22df912ce18f930028649de29cff96.jpg[/img]

Dog and Goblin is an auto-battler roguelike deck-building strategy game. This time, you’re not a revered human hero—instead, you’ll assemble a mixed army to stand against the humans. With nearly 200 cards and 19 different types to choose from, build your ultimate army and conquer their castles!

We welcome your valuable feedback on the game experience, and we will continue to refine the full version based on your input.
Discord：https://discord.gg/AW3pUXStQ2

notes.title: Translation Reworked
notes.content:
A lot of players gave feedbacks on the game's English translation. I tried to work on it a few times on my own, but didnt find better words to use. 

Some streamers start to play my game on stream so I start to take it seriously. I referenced the good old Magic:The Gathering and HearthStone, they use simple descriptions to deliver complex gameplay. And luckily, I have some friends to help me with it recently. 

All the English texts in the game have been reworked. 

It's still not perfect, but I'm open to feedbacks in any form. Hope you guys understand this is a strategy game with a lot of mecanisms that once you see it happens, you know how it works, and it's just hard to explain it in plain text. In the end it is not a constitution law.

I'm sure the game experience is better now. Have fun!

notes.title: Version 1.2 Big Update is Live!
notes.content:

20+ enemies have their unique skills! You'd better destroy the fort ASAP, or the king would exile your deck!
[b]Character Pick:[/b]
Player can now choose a character from these 5: Cleric, Commander, Recruiter, Sourcerer, Black Magician. They have different play styles and try to make synergy with your cards.

[list]
[*] The whole stats system is reworked and balanced. Hopefully you will find the game not too hard or too ez. But still, feel free to come to Discord and tell us the cards you like or not!
 [list]
[*] Weak build like poison are buffed (poison damage now ignores armor).
[*]  Legendary cards are less important, they still need a good deck to release the full  power
[*]  Try it out in the game!
[/list][*] Coin UI Remake.
[*] Some VFX and SFX added.
[*] Attack Animation timescale reworked so low damage cards attacks faster and high damage cards slower.

[/list]
[b]Bug fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Tutorial display bug fixed.
